Lemma
[Infinitesimal convexity] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0444, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iii:page-0445 1. apph:H.18\group Locally convex subsets If $V_1,V_2$ are unit vectors whose short radial geodesics lie in $\operatorname {int}(C)$, then all sufficiently short radial geodesics in directions between them lie in $\operatorname {int}(C)$. The same holds when the first radial geodesic lies in $C$ and the second in its interior, provided the interpolation parameter is positive.
